name: Crenaly – Online Booking for Salons
author: crenalycom

sections.description:
Crenaly is appointment booking software for hair salons, beauty institutes and independent practitioners. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Crenaly business:

  • One-click connection: click “Connecter à Crenaly”, pick your business, done. No code to copy, no key to paste.
  • “Prestations Crenaly” block: your list of services with durations and prices, always up to date. Each row opens booking on the right service.
  • “Réservation Crenaly” block: a booking button for any page, or the booking shown directly in the page. In the page you choose a list or cards (2 to 4 columns), the header, tabs by category (with or without background) and which services to offer.
  • Shortcodes [crenaly], [crenaly prestation="soin-visage"] and [crenaly_prestations] for Elementor, Divi and other page builders. To show the booking in the page: [crenaly affichage="page" mise_en_page="cartes" colonnes="3" entete="non" groupes="oui" onglets="sans-fond" prestations="soin-visage,massage"].
  • Site-wide button, bottom right or left, with your own text and icon (image or SVG).
  • Dashboard: bookings that came from your site this month and your next 5 appointments.
  • Booking opens on your site: clients pick a service and a time slot and, if you enabled it, pay a deposit without leaving your site.
  • Button color, default text and the page shown after booking are set once in Crenaly › Intégration.

A Crenaly account is required. On the free plan the button opens your Crenaly booking page in a new tab; on the Pro plan booking opens directly on your site. Plan differences are applied by the Crenaly service: the plugin code is the same for everyone.

The plugin interface is in French.

External services

This plugin connects to the Crenaly service (https://crenaly.com), operated by Crenaly, to display online booking for your business.

  • Connection (once, by the site administrator): clicking “Connecter à Crenaly” opens crenaly.com in the browser with your site address. After you approve, the plugin exchanges a one-time code for a connection key with api.crenaly.com. Data sent: your site address.
  • Business information (when the Crenaly menu is opened, then at most every 15 minutes while the site receives visits): the plugin reads from api.crenaly.com the business name and address, the button settings and the list of services (name, description, duration, price). Data sent: the connection key.
  • Upcoming appointments (when the Crenaly dashboard is opened in WordPress, then every minute while it stays open): the plugin reads from api.crenaly.com the next 5 appointments (time, service, client first name and last initial, staff member, channel, status) and the number of bookings that came from the site. No email address or phone number is sent; this data is cached for one minute only and never stored in WordPress. Only site administrators can see it. Data sent: the connection key.
  • Booking (on pages that show the button): the script https://crenaly.com/embed.js is loaded on the visitor’s page. When a visitor books, their details (name, email, phone, chosen time slot) are entered directly in a window served by crenaly.com; they do not go through WordPress and are not stored by the plugin.
  • Disconnection or plugin removal: the plugin tells api.crenaly.com that the connection is removed. Data sent: the connection key.

Terms of use: https://crenaly.com/cgu
Privacy policy: https://crenaly.com/confidentialite
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins › Add New and search for “Crenaly”.
  2. Install and activate the plugin, then open the “Crenaly” menu.
  3. Click “Connecter à Crenaly” and approve your site.
  4. Add the “Prestations Crenaly” or “Réservation Crenaly” block to a page, or turn on the site-wide button.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Crenaly account?

Yes. You can create one with a free 30-day trial at https://crenaly.com.

Where do I set the button text and color?

In Crenaly › Paramètres › Intégration. The same setting applies to the blocks and shortcodes. For the site-wide button you can choose a different text and an icon in WordPress.

Why upload an SVG in the plugin instead of the media library?

WordPress blocks SVG files for security reasons. The plugin keeps only the shapes of the drawing (scripts, links and external content are removed) and displays it as an image.

My site uses a cache plugin (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed…).

The button works with cache plugins. If an option delays JavaScript, the booking window opens on the first click once the script has loaded.

How do I remove booking from my site?

Crenaly menu › Déconnecter, or Crenaly › Paramètres › Intégration. Nothing is deleted from your Crenaly account.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • “Réservation Crenaly” block: new “Dans la page” display with list or cards, 2 to 4 columns, header, tabs by category and service choice. Also available in the [crenaly] shortcode.

1.1.0

  • New Crenaly menu: dashboard, services, settings.
  • “Prestations Crenaly” block and [crenaly_prestations] shortcode.
  • Site-wide button: text, icon (image or SVG) and mobile display.
  • One-click “Réserver” page creation.

1.0.0

  • First release: one-click connection, “Réservation Crenaly” block, [crenaly] shortcode, site-wide button.
